Thanks Naomi — I reviewed the SOW and Lumenova's cashflow model. Initial thoughts and recommended controls: 

1) Time-limited policy: Approve quarterly invoicing + Net-90 for two quarters (Q1 & Q4 2027) as a pilot. After pilot, revert to standard monthly terms unless relationship justifies continuation.

2) Security for Redwood: Require a 25% deposit of expected quarterly invoice at onboarding (applied to first invoice of the quarter) OR a performance escrow agreement for the first two quarters.

3) Usage & credit guardrails: Hard usage cap mapped to contract value + automated alerts at 75% consumption; any overage billed on a 30-day term and due immediately.

4) Reporting & review cadence: Finance/AE joint review after each quarter with explicit go/no-go metrics.

5) Discount trade: If Lumenova elects Net-90, reduce standard onboarding discount by 2.5 percentage points OR offer a 1% early-pay discount if paid within 15 days.

If leadership is comfortable with these conditional terms we can document them in an addendum and mark the HubSpot deal with 'conditional_terms:quarterly_net90_pilot'.

I'll draft suggested language for the amendment if you want.

Rishi
